name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Conversion & Growth Optimization Leader | Experimentation, Funnel Analytics & SEO
summary: Growth and conversion operator with 15+ years across SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, focused on the moment a visitor becomes a lead and a lead becomes a paying customer. Founder of Solenzo, where I build the full conversion layer myself: landing pages, first-party data capture, segmentation, triggered lifecycle journeys, technical SEO, and the GA4/GTM measurement that shows what is working. Earlier, at Wix, I led conversion-focused site consultations for a high-value e-commerce portfolio (25% conversion lift and 30% traffic growth across the segment) and ran a team of up to 20 onboarding specialists. I use AI daily as a working tool, not a talking point.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built and run a free digital-footprint audit offer as a top-of-funnel registration play, distributed through my own LinkedIn growth: 180+ businesses enrolled, 2 converted to paying clients (~1.1% free-to-paid).

Architected a 20+ workflow conversion and lifecycle system in GoHighLevel spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, booking with confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, onboarding nurture, and reactivation.

Design first-party data capture and segmentation (contact tagging, lifecycle stages, strict data hygiene) in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, feeding personalized outreach from scored behavioral and footprint signals.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account to cut spam and low-quality leads, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck, tracing the full funnel from click to lead.

Run technical SEO audits, keyword gap analysis, and schema/structured-data implementation using Screaming Frog, and install Google Tag Manager and GA4 tracking directly in HTML/CSS on every site built.
Build dashboards and evaluation loops tracking funnel progression, campaign ROI, and conversion rates, using SQL on BigQuery/GA4 data, and iterate on landing pages and copy from the results.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Designed and ran A/B-tested LinkedIn ad campaigns using an account-based approach, targeting small, highly researched audiences rather than broad segments.
Produced conversion-focused landing pages, multi-touch email sequences, and campaign copy that improved lead generation and pipeline.
Built campaign reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and turned the data into optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Coordinated integrated strategy across inbound, paid media, and content, aligning internal teams on a shared execution plan.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Built automated product-training and communication sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to find adoption gaps, and fed structured, prioritized customer feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed paid media and creative performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations for client accounts.
Led the sales team while carrying my own accounts, and rebuilt internal processes to improve reporting accuracy and reduce handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led digital growth consultations on site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO for a high-value e-commerce portfolio, contributing to a 25% improvement in conversion rates and a 30% increase in website traffic across the segment.
Advised on A/B testing strategy for a Salesforce-based workflow-automation effort, defining test structure and success criteria for the team building it.
Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8), helping take a new Wix vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, and built Zapier automations connecting client systems.
